description:
Join a premier skilled nursing facility in Oakland, MD, as a Staff Development & Infection Control Nurse (RN). This pivotal full-time role offers a unique opportunity to shape staff competency and safeguard resident health by leading both educational initiatives and robust infection prevention programs. We are seeking a dedicated professional to ensure our team is well-trained and our environment remains safe and compliant.

In this dual capacity, you will be instrumental in fostering a culture of continuous learning and upholding the highest standards of infection control. Your expertise will directly impact the quality of care provided, making a significant difference in the lives of our residents and the professional growth of our staff. This urgent opening offers a competitive hourly rate of $40.00 - $42.00, reflecting your valuable skills and experience.

If you are an experienced Registered Nurse passionate about education and public health, and ready to take on a challenging yet rewarding role, we encourage you to apply. This is an excellent opportunity to advance your career within a supportive and dynamic healthcare environment.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland
Minimum of 2 years of experience in staff development or education
Minimum of 2 years of experience in infection prevention and control
Strong understanding of state and federal healthcare regulations
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $40.00 - $42.00, compensation based on experience.

description:
We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Marketing Director to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Sarasota County, FL. This is a highly confidential opportunity for a driven individual who is presentable, professional, and possesses a strong track record in marketing and business development. This role offers excellent compensation for the right candidate who is ready to make a significant impact.

As the Marketing Director, you will be instrumental in driving census growth and enhancing community engagement. The ideal candidate is a proactive "hustler" with the ability to develop and execute effective marketing strategies. This position requires flexibility, including the ability to work occasional weekends to meet business needs and engage with the community.
requirements: Proven track record in marketing and business development, preferably within a healthcare or skilled nursing environment
Presentable and professional demeanor with strong interpersonal skills
Ability to work occasional weekends as needed
Experience driving census growth and community engagement
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation based on experience for the right candidate.

description:
We are urgently seeking a dedicated PRN Speech Language Pathologist (SLP) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Inverness, FL. This critical role offers a competitive hourly rate and the flexibility of PRN scheduling, perfect for professionals looking to make a significant impact while managing their own schedule. You will be an integral part of a compassionate team, providing essential speech and language services to patients.

This is an excellent opportunity for an SLP seeking a rewarding position with immediate impact. We are offering a generous $5,000 sign-on or relocation bonus to welcome the right candidate to our team. Join us and contribute to a patient-centered environment focused on recovery and well-being.
requirements: Current Florida state licensure as a Speech-Language Pathologist
Certificate of Clinical Competence (CCC-SLP) from ASHA
Experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting
salaryOrBonusInfo: $38.00 - $49.00/hr with a $5,000 sign-on or relocation bonus.

description:
A premier health and rehabilitation center in Inverness, FL is seeking a dedicated Physical Therapist (PT) for a Per Diem (PRN) role. This is an excellent opportunity for a skilled therapist to provide high-quality care and make a significant impact on patient recovery and well-being within a supportive environment. We are looking for a compassionate professional eager to contribute to a team-oriented setting.

As a PRN Physical Therapist, you will be responsible for assessing, planning, and implementing individualized treatment programs for patients, helping them regain mobility, reduce pain, and improve their overall quality of life. This flexible role offers the chance to work on an as-needed basis, providing valuable support to our therapy team and ensuring continuous, excellent patient care. Join a facility committed to clinical excellence and patient-centered outcomes.
requirements: Current state licensure as a Physical Therapist (PT)
Experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting preferred
Strong clinical assessment and treatment planning skills
Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly compensation for Physical Therapists ranges from $39.00 to $40.00, based on experience.
